title: After burning the Hundred Gallery, Tamsin says 'Whatever's left of the truth about that mine burns with it,' implying the evidence is gone, but the very same scene still lets me confront Preceptor Aldous with 'the truth' minutes later as if the ledger's contents survived intact.
where: The Hundred Gallery — Ash / Ironbound Chapterhouse, Cinderhall
